checks.text: Typing 1 in From value shows 3.28084 in To value (From unit Meters, To unit Feet, as the app opens).
Typing 1 in To value shows 0.3048 in From value.
Choosing Temperature in Category, then typing 100 in From value shows 212 in To value; replacing it with -40 shows -40 in To value.

After typing 1 in From value, choosing Mass in Category sets From unit to Kilograms and To unit to Pounds and empties both From value and To value; typing 1 in From value then shows 2.20462 in To value.
With 1 in From value (Meters to Feet), clicking Swap sets From unit to Feet and To unit to Meters, keeps 1 in From value, and shows 0.3048 in To value.
Typing abc in From value shows the text "Enter a number." below the field, leaves To value empty, and the page shows the text NaN nowhere.

Typing 1 in From value and clicking Save adds the entry "1 Meters = 3.28084 Feet" to the Recent list; then typing 2 and clicking Save puts "2 Meters = 6.56168 Feet" first and "1 Meters = 3.28084 Feet" second.

Saving the values 1 through 11 in turn (type the value in From value, click Save) leaves exactly 10 entries in Recent: the first is "11 Meters = 36.08924 Feet", the last is "2 Meters = 6.56168 Feet", and no entry reads exactly "1 Meters = 3.28084 Feet".

After saving 11 (Meters to Feet), typing 7 in From value and then clicking the Recent entry "11 Meters = 36.08924 Feet" puts 11 in From value and 36.08924 in To value, with Category Length, From unit Meters and To unit Feet.
Reload keeps the Recent list: after saving 1 and then 2 and reloading the page, Recent shows "2 Meters = 6.56168 Feet" first and "1 Meters = 3.28084 Feet" second.
